meaning.en: The fourth division of the stomach in ruminant animals, such as cows, sheep, and deer, in which digestion takes place.

meaning.en: The fourth, or digesting, chamber of the stomach of a cud-chewing animal, as the cow.

meaning.en: (anatomy) The fourth or digestive compartment of the stomach of a cow or other ruminant, after the omasum.
meaning.vi: (giải phẫu học) Ngăn thứ tư hoặc ngăn tiêu hóa của dạ dày của bò hoặc động vật nhai lại khác, sau omasum.

sentences.en: It was conclusion that abomasum glutin infusion could increase total opioid-like bioactivity of abomasal digesta and improve rumen metabolism and endocrine of sheep.

sentences.en: The effect of selective vagotomy of the abomasum, pylorus, duodenum and liver on insulin release during the cephalic phase of digestion was investigated in wethers and lactating ewes.

sentences.en: Chymosin used traditionally in cheese making is an aspartic protease extracted form abomasum of suckling calves.
